prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1163; do not mention it.)
text: I was stopped at a red light on the main road in Conroe, Texas, waiting to turn left, when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The vehicle that hit me did not appear to slow down before impact. My car was pushed forward into the intersection and the airbags did not deploy. I got out to check the damage, which included a crumpled rear bumper and a cracked taillight on my vehicle. The other driver and I exchanged insurance information, and a police officer came to the scene and filed a report. Shortly afterward I began to feel stiffness and sharp pain in my lower back, which has continued since. I have been advised to rest and attend physical therapy sessions. I am submitting this statement to document the collision and my resulting injury.
